note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 by an independent auditor after the userns conversion. The unit's only change since the last verdict is userns.Enter(t) as its first statement (the child re-runs the whole body in its own user, network and mount namespace; a child failure or skip propagates to the parent, and a child that ran nothing fails it) plus removal of EPERM/EACCES skips, so a refused privilege now fails instead of skipping. Assertions are byte-identical. Section 2.0: 'A failing comparison must result in the segment being dropped and must not produce any response back to the sender.' TestRFC2385MalformedWireSignaturesAreDropped raw-sends to a keyed RealListenerFactory listener a SYN whose Kind 19 digest alone is corrupted with valid IP/TCP checksums, follows it with non-TCP noise, and rfc2385ExpectReply fails on any TCP reply to that port in a bounded 300ms window; an independently signed control on the next port must then get a SYNACK whose digest the independent oracle verifies, so silence is not a dead path. Bounded packet evidence, not unlimited silence. TestRFC2385MatchingKeysCarryASignedSession (unchanged) is the keyed-session positive. Producer: network.go Listen installing the key via setTCPMD5Sig; Linux TCP compares.
